model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between two indices, “Index” and “Schuldenquote,” over time. The second line, shown in green and marked with circles, starts at approximately 60 at the year 1995 and increases to approximately 60 at the year 2000, then decreases to approximately 40 at the year 2005, before increasing to approximately 50 at the year 2010, and finally increasing to approximately 80 at the year 2020.
